title: protocols/MCP/* payload
description: Payload for a wrapped MCP message. It is the `params.payload` of a request-envelope.json request whose `method` is `protocols/MCP/<mcp_method>` (or the explicit-version form `wrapped:mcp-<version>/<mcp_method>`). The payload carries one MCP JSON-RPC message in decomposed form, so the ACS envelope never nests a second JSON-RPC envelope. `mcp_method` MUST equal the part of the ACS `method` after `protocols/MCP/` (or after `wrapped:mcp-<version>/`). `direction` says which MCP message the payload carries: `request` is a message the Observed Agent is about to send to the MCP server, `response` is a message the MCP server returned and the Observed Agent has not yet consumed, and `notification` is an MCP notification in either direction. The Guardian answers every wrapped message with an AcsResult (mcp-result.json), including a notification, because the ACS request carries its own JSON-RPC `id`.

direction.description: Which MCP message this payload carries. 'request': agent to MCP server, held until the Guardian decides. 'response': MCP server to agent, held until the Guardian decides. 'notification': an MCP notification, which has no MCP id and no MCP response.

mcp_method.description: The MCP method name, for example 'tools/call', 'resources/read', 'prompts/get', 'initialize' or 'notifications/resources/updated'. A 'response' repeats the method of the request it answers, so the Guardian does not have to look the request up.

mcp_id.description: The MCP JSON-RPC id. Required on 'request' and 'response'. Absent on 'notification'. It is the MCP id, not the ACS id: the two are unrelated and a Guardian MUST NOT assume they are equal.

mcp_params.description: The MCP `params` object, unmodified. Present on a 'request' or 'notification' when the MCP message has params. Absent on a 'response'.

mcp_result.description: The MCP `result` object, unmodified. Present on a successful 'response'. Exactly one of mcp_result and mcp_error is present on a 'response'.

mcp_error.description: The MCP JSON-RPC error object, unmodified. Present on a failed 'response'.

server_id.description: Deployment-chosen identifier of the MCP server the message goes to or came from. Lets a Guardian key policy on the server. It SHOULD match the AgBOM component identifier for that server when the deployment emits an AgBOM.

transport.description: The MCP transport between the Observed Agent and the MCP server. This is not the ACS transport negotiated in the handshake.

protocol_version.description: The MCP protocol version in use on that connection (for example '2025-06-18'). It SHOULD be one of the versions the Observed Agent declared in `wrapped_protocols` at handshake.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL. Provenance of the content a 'response' carries. For resources/read, prompts/get and tools/call results the Observed Agent labels the content with the origin the channel gives it (for example 'retrieved' or 'tool_output'), so the Guardian can apply policy keyed on origin and source_id before the content reaches the model.
